controller_policy.direct_fast_path: unique production definition for an explicit code-like prompt symbol
controller_policy.ambiguous_path: emit candidate frontier for external semantic judge; never force deterministic top-1

evidence_card.selection: weighted query-signal coverage with exact match preference; lexical-prefix support is used only inside an already-selected candidate file

freeze_rule: Do not modify candidate ranking, proof rule, TOP_K, card selection, lexical matching, context radius, or card budget after unseen taskset construction/execution begins. Any change requires a new frozen version and a new unseen taskset.
judge_boundary: The external semantic judge receives only task text and authenticated candidate cards. Candidate order/rank, expected file, expected anchor, repository search output, and development labels are withheld.
claim_boundary: Development gate is seen-task mechanics only. Generalization claims require a post-freeze unseen repository taskset and blind semantic-judge scoring.
